drafted_from: tools/reply-by-keyword-rule/tool-rows.json (tool:send-a-reply-on-instagram), do-work/send-a-reply.mjs, read-data/reply-places.json, test/decide-and-send.test.mjs; the example was run on the test fixture with a stand-in network
start_here: Say to your AI: "Send the Instagram reply that tool:decide-the-replies chose for the message that asked the price from my Instagram account." It runs tool:send-a-reply-on-instagram with account_id and that one decision and tells you whether it was sent.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes one decision and keeps only its own reply-kept record for that decision, so a reply is sent once.
instructions: 1. Connect your Instagram account first; its connection is named service_connection:instagram or service_connection:instagram:<name>.
2. Run tool:decide-the-replies for the place and keep only a decision whose action is send; this tool refuses any other.
3. Say "Send that reply": the AI runs tool:send-a-reply-on-instagram at @workshop-tools with {account_id, decision}. It posts publicly on your account, so run it only for replies your rules chose.

4. Read status: sent (with key and message_id), already-sent (that key has a record and nothing is sent again), refused (with reason: window-closed, host-not-allowed or unknown-kind), failed (with what the place said) or not-known (no answer came back; look on the place yourself, it is never retried).

worked_examples.title: Send the price reply to a direct message, once
worked_examples.ask: Send the reply my rules chose for the price message.

decision.reply_text: Hi, the price list is here.

worked_examples.given: From tools/reply-by-keyword-rule/test/decide-and-send.test.mjs (the "posts once inside the window" test, run here with a stand-in network that answers {"recipient_id":"them","message_id":"mid-1"}): the decision is the one tool:decide-the-replies chose for msg-1 (5 minutes old, inside the 24 hour window). The request goes to https://graph.instagram.com/v21.0/me/messages with {"recipient":{"id":"them"},"message":{"text":"Hi, the price list is here."}}.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"status":"sent","key":"msg-1:rule:prices","message_id":"mid-1"}; the kept record then reads {state: "sent", message_id: "mid-1"}, and running it again answers {"status":"already-sent","key":"msg-1:rule:prices"} without a request. The same decision with created_time 25 hours before now answers {"status":"refused","reason":"window-closed","key":...} and nothing is sent or kept.
